support_claim: The CRM row for VEL-19 lists the vendor as "Vellum Print Co" while billing records a billed name of "Vellum Print Co Ltd", but no observation links the CRM identifier to that billing name or otherwise establishes identity or distinctness.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; the packet provides only parallel name mentions without a cross-reference, shared identifier, or explicit statement of sameness or difference, so neither burden is met and UNRESOLVED is licensed.
